questions.question: From where does the psalmist cry to the LORD in Psalm 130?
What would happen if God marked iniquities, according to the psalm?
options: No one could stand, but with him there is forgiveness
Only the righteous would be left standing before him
He himself would greatly rejoice over their downfall
Every single soul would surely be saved in the end
questions.answer: No one could stand, but with him there is forgiveness
